title: Multiple NDEr shares about wars in heaven and on earth

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Reported viewing self in airplane seat from above; also simultaneously seeing aisles, steward prep area, back of airplane; then outside the plane looking in with multiple angles at once; then back inside and outside again.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: No fear when outside the plane; illness/pain stopped abruptly once out of body.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Peripheral vision of a white male figure recognized as “the Savior of the World”; later says he recognized the comforting narrator as his “Father in Heaven.”
arrival.other_being_detail: A man pacing on a rocky desert island shore; experiencer felt they had agreed to help him in this life though they had not met yet.

environment.environment_other_detail: Standing over a large body of deep dark cobalt-blue water; rocky desert island bordering the water; wooden table with a book (Book of Life).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Also stated “I knew at that moment I needed to go back.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Second NDE occurred on an airplane during severe flu/dehydration with seizing, breathlessness, and intense leg pain; first NDE during emergency C-section with toxic shock from streptococcus B; later multiple NDEs associated with heart failure episodes and other illnesses.

person_demographics.location_city: North Salt Lake; San Antonio; Tooele County mentioned
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Self-identifies as Christian; uses Father in Heaven/Savior language; references Bible and Second Coming.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Book of Life; symbolic objects/ancient symbols (some connected to music); “veil was thin” period with visions/premonitions; extensive premortal/War-in-Heaven teachings across later NDEs.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE on plane (inside/outside) followed by arrival to scene over water with table/Book of Life and peripheral figure identified as Savior; then return motivated by need to help children.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated shifting between inside plane looking down at body and outside the plane.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneous multi-directional perception: seeing many angles/locations at once (aisles, prep area, back of airplane).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Peripheral-avoidance of looking directly at the Savior figure due to concern it would prevent return; Book of Life on a wooden table while standing over dark cobalt water; repeated inside/outside airplane vantage; post-NDE “thin veil” for ~2 weeks with intense precognition/visions; later NDE teachings about pre-existence, War in Heaven linked to Big Bang, three wave-like wars, and Satan as cause of Big Bang; claims of spillover into Earth realm with strange lights/explosions/crafts.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself looking down to see myself in the seat… I also began to see in many different directions all at once.”; “There was a wooden table in front of me with a book on it… it was the Book of Life and I felt like my name was in it.”; “Somehow I sensed that I should NOT look directly at him, because if I did I wouldn’t ever want to go back into my body.”; “For weeks after this NDE, the veil was still very thin with me.”
